title: Pixel Creatures
description: Fast, tactical mobs that circle around you, reverse direction mid-attack, and challenge your combat skills.
body:
![Banner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/etbitpixel/PixelCreatures-CDN/refs/heads/main/banner%20V2.png)

Pixel Creature is a Neoforge mod that adds two new hostile mobs to Minecraft. These creatures attack in a special way, instead of just running straight toward the player like most monsters, they move around the player in circles. After each attack, they switch direction, sometimes going clockwise, sometimes counter-clockwise. This makes them harder to hit and more fun to fight.

Additionally, during their rotational attacks, the creatures are smart enough to detect and avoid water and lava, preventing them from falling into hazardous terrain.

![Creatures](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/etbitpixel/PixelCreatures-CDN/refs/heads/main/CreaturesV2.png)
